nodes.label: VetoEffects
nodes.rationale: Implements the shared glow/ping visual effects once, for the same structural reason as VetoComponentCore: a form component cannot derive from VetoComponentBase, so shared behaviour must live somewhere neither base class owns. Effects render on a pseudo-element of the root, which is why VetoTextBox carries the effect on its wrapper rather than the bare input/img element that cannot host a pseudo-element.
